text: A true and regular affection ought to spring and increase with the knowledge they give us of themselves, and then, if they are worthy of it, the natural propension walking hand in hand with reason, to cherish them with a truly paternal love.
author: Michel de Montaigne
locator: Book II, Chapter 8, Of the Affection of Fathers to their Children
translation: Charles Cotton, ed. W. C. Hazlitt, 1877
